text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

Panel composition alone proves nothing. In news and HR, all-women panels occur frequently by chance or role distribution, and panels of one sex don't reliably favour their own. More importantly, there's a visible, plausible reason you lost: she was credited with strong digital experience, which is exactly what public broadcasters are currently restructuring around. Fifteen years of service doesn't outweigh the capability they said they wanted.

Raising sex now, with no evidence beyond the headcount, would likely be read as sour grapes and would damage your standing internally — a real cost if you're staying.

Do chase the written explanation; you're owed it. Judge it on its reasoning, and reassess only if it's evasive or inconsistent.
